item.title: 2026-10-07 · 利比亚议会换了新负责人
item.description: Libya's parliament removes Speaker Aguila Saleh after 12 years (Al Jazeera). Australia's High Court rules against a coal mine expansion over climate harm (Al Jazeera). China's railways set a one-day record of 25.2 million trips on National Day (China State Railway Group, via Business Today); Evergrande liquidators sue former associates (SCMP). Germany's coalition fights over budget-gap taxes on sugar, plastic and crypto (Bloomberg); Merz pledges 1 billion euros more aid in Kyiv (CNBC). Vocabulary: 状态 zhuàngtài, 国庆 Guóqìng, 补假 bǔjià, 你说怎么办 nǐ shuō zěnme bàn, 法律 fǎlǜ, 心疼 xīnténg, 直接 zhíjiē, 搜 sōu. Explained: 议会 yìhuì (parliament), 煤 méi (coal), 税 shuì (tax), 无人机 wúrénjī (drone), 基辅 Jīfù (Kyiv).
